dict.string: Greenroom arranges Google Chrome windows for you (e.g. tiling a new window to half the screen).
Greenroom sends the composited video (your screen with you in it) to the Zoom meeting from inside the app, so it needs the camera the meeting uses.

Your microphone goes to the Zoom meeting and drives the level meter on the participants panel. With Prompter turned on (off by default), Greenroom also turns your speech into text on this Mac to suggest links; the audio and the text never leave the Mac and are not saved.
